defect: The added read_amp_bytes_per_bit parse hook stores the value with EncodeFixed32, which writes little-endian bytes into a native uint32 field, so the option is loaded wrongly on big-endian machines.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added EncodeFixed32 call with a native uint32 store, and the misuse of an encoding helper on a struct field is visible in the diff.

defect: BuildLevelIterators was changed to assign level_iters_[level - 1] after only reserve() (and after Cleanup cleared the vector, while RenewIterators never clears it), writing past the vector size (undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix restores push_back with a clear/reserve in BuildLevelIterators, repairing the operator[]-after-reserve pattern this change introduced, which is evident from the diff.

defect: The new GetIntVal computes local `levels` only for an assert, so release (NDEBUG) builds fail with -Werror=unused-variable.
reason: The fix inlines the expression into the assert to remove the unused variable that this change added; RocksDB builds with -Werror, so it is a compile failure on a supported configuration.

defect: The fix adds more crash-test options and replaces the enable_tiered_storage handling with explicit temperature flags.
reason: The later change is a test-coverage feature, not a repair of a defect in the bottommost_temperature to last_level_temperature rename.

defect: The fix uses the return value of std::unique so that only unique pinned pointers are released, instead of releasing the whole vector including the unspecified tail.
reason: The pre-change code already called std::unique without using its result and then deleted every element, so the defect predates this refactoring.

defect: The fix renames env_ to env in the TwoPhaseMultiThreadTest callback after the fixture member was renamed.
reason: At this commit the fixture member was env_, so the code compiled; the build break came from the later commit a6254f2 that renamed the member to env without updating these lines.

defect: SplitValueIntoChunks allocates chunks with AllocateBlock (which uses the configured MemoryAllocator) and releases the raw pointer, but the chunks are later freed with delete[] in CacheValueChunk::Free, an allocator mismatch that segfaults.
reason: The fix replaces the added AllocateBlock call with new char[] to match the delete[] in Free, which is defined in the header and needed to see the mismatch.

defect: The fix restores the original WAL and FLUSH test expectations after fixing DBImpl's destructor to flush all column families.
reason: In this file the fix only reverts test expectations; the real defect (flush on destroy only for the default column family) is in db_impl.cc and predates this change.

defect: The fix makes blob DB GC use GetForUpdate inside the optimistic transaction so a concurrent write cannot slip in between the sequence-number check and the delete or relocate.
reason: The GC race the fix repairs existed before this logging cleanup; the change only touched log lines and a statistics counter that the fix rewrites as part of its redesign.

defect: The fix renames GC stats fields in the tests, adjusts TTL boundaries and adds new GC race tests.
reason: The changes to this test file adapt it to the GC transaction redesign; the test added by this change is not itself defective.

defect: The fix changes the test's key i to a merge operand so that the test covers the merge path of kRemoveAndSkipUntil.
reason: In this file the fix only strengthens the test; the actual defect (StartPinning without ReleasePinnedData) lives in merge_helper.cc, not in these test lines.

defect: AddPrefix now calls AddKey(prefix), which appends the prefix to entries_, before recording prev_prefix_start_ = entries_.size(), so the saved previous-prefix offset points past the prefix.
reason: The fix moves AddKey after saving prev_prefix_start_/size, repairing the reordering introduced here, which is visible in the diff.

defect: The added check compares max_bytes_for_level_multiplier_additional.size() (size_t) with num_levels (int), a signed/unsigned comparison that fails the build under -Werror=sign-compare.
reason: The fix casts num_levels in exactly this added comparison; seeing that num_levels is an int requires the options header.

defect: The fix only updates the call get_context->tracing_get_id() to the renamed accessor get_tracing_get_id().
reason: The -Wshadow problem comes from the accessor name added in get_context.h by another commit; this change's line merely calls it and is renamed as a consequence.

defect: The change adds a member function tracing_get_id() with the same name as the new constructor parameter tracing_get_id, so the constructor definition triggers -Werror=shadow.
reason: The fix renames the added accessor to get_tracing_get_id to remove the shadowing, and both clashing names appear in this diff.

defect: In CacheSimulator::miss_ratio the local variable total_accesses shadows the member function total_accesses(), failing the build with -Werror=shadow.
reason: The fix renames exactly this local variable added by the change, and the clashing function is defined right below it in the diff.

defect: ReleaseSnapshot uses versions_->LastSequence() as the oldest snapshot when none remain, but with concurrent_prepare_ and seq_per_batch_ snapshots are taken at LastToBeWrittenSequence, so the oldest-snapshot value can move backwards and trip an assertion.
reason: The fix makes these added lines use the same conditional as GetSnapshotImpl, which sits just above in the diff.

defect: The new FireOnFlushCompletedAfterCommittedResult test waits only for the first flush to be scheduled, so the second flush can be merged into the first job and the test hangs.
reason: The fix changes the added sync-point dependency to wait for BackgroundCallFlush:start; understanding the race needs DBImpl's flush scheduling code.

defect: Timer computes wake-up times from env_->NowMicros() but waits on a port::CondVar whose TimedWait uses the system clock, so with a mock-time Env the timer misbehaves and its tests hang (on macOS).
reason: The fix switches the added mutex and condvar to InstrumentedMutex/InstrumentedCondVar so mock time can drive TimedWait; seeing the clock mismatch requires the port and Env code.

defect: The fix re-enables the timer tests this change disabled, after fixing the macOS hang in timer.h.
reason: Disabling tests is not a defect; the hang being worked around was in timer.h, introduced elsewhere.

defect: The fix changes the closing comment from ROCKSDB_LITE to !ROCKSDB_LITE.
reason: This file's part of the fix is a comment change only; no defect in managed_iterator.h is repaired.

defect: The fix parameterizes the timestamp tests over index types and adds a Get/MultiGet test for a key-comparison bug in the table reader.
reason: The changes to this test file add coverage for a pre-existing table reader bug; the tests added by this change are not defective.

defect: Name() and NeedCompact() override virtual functions without the override keyword while sibling methods use it, which clang rejects under -Winconsistent-missing-override with -Werror.
reason: The fix adds override to exactly these two added methods, and the inconsistency is visible in the new header.

defect: The NowMicros fallback was changed from system_clock to high_resolution_clock, which is not wall-clock time, although NowMicros must return system time for condition-variable TimedWait; on Windows 7 this causes 100% CPU.
reason: The fix reverts this changed line to system_clock, and the comment stating the system-time requirement is in the diff context.

defect: The fix renames the loop variable log_size_for_fush to log_size_for_flush.
reason: The fix corrects a typo in a variable name; it repairs no functional defect.

defect: The fix pops prepared_txns_ only after setting delayed_prepared_empty_ to false, so a concurrent SmallestUnCommittedSeq cannot miss an entry that is in neither structure.
reason: The same pop-before-flag ordering already existed in AdvanceMaxEvictedSeq before this change; the change only moved the loop into CheckPreparedAgainstMax.

defect: ThreadStatusSingleCompaction depends on a misspelled sync point "CompactionJob::Run:~CompactionJob()" that does not exist, so the dependency never holds and the test fails.
reason: The fix corrects this added sync-point name to CompactionJob::~CompactionJob(); knowing the correct name requires compaction_job.cc.

defect: The fix stops setting manifest_file_number_ from next_file and instead parses it from CURRENT in Recover, and drops it from the DumpManifest output.
reason: The manifest_file_number_ = next_file assignment is unchanged context that predates this change, and the Recover part is outside this change.

defect: The new flag uses DEFINE_uint32, which is unavailable in the gflags versions on some supported platforms, so db_bench fails to compile there.
reason: The fix switches this added flag to DEFINE_uint64 with a cast; knowing that DEFINE_uint32 is missing needs the gflags headers.

defect: The fix removes a stray closing brace of the anonymous namespace left after a merge.
reason: At this commit the anonymous namespace was opened and closed consistently; the mismatch came from merge 1a1b953 with a branch that removed the opening namespace.

defect: The new parsing assigns strtoul results (unsigned long) to uint32_t num_files and checksum_value, an implicit 64-to-32 narrowing that fails the clang build with -Wshorten-64-to-32 -Werror.
reason: The fix adds casts on exactly these added strtoul assignments; the build enabled -Wshorten-64-to-32 at the time.

defect: FlushOneColumnFamily compares tables.size() (size_t) with int i + 1, a signed/unsigned comparison that breaks the -Werror build.
reason: The fix makes the loop variable size_t and the literal unsigned in this added test.

defect: The fix moves the assert-only count variable inside #ifndef NDEBUG to silence an unused-variable warning.
reason: The build at that time did not use -Werror, so the unused variable was only a warning, not a compile failure or functional defect.

defect: The fix passes the new Env argument to the GetContext constructor in table_reader_bench.
reason: The GetContext call matched the constructor at this commit; the build break came from commit 3d1a924 adding an Env parameter without updating this caller.

defect: OpenDb allocates options.comparator = new TestKeyComparator() on every call and never deletes it, leaking memory in the test.
reason: The fix moves this allocation into the constructor paired with a delete in the destructor, repairing the leak from the line this change added.

defect: The sync-point callback casts the argument of Version::VerifySstUniqueIds::Passed to std::string*, but it is a UniqueId64x2*, so the test reads it with the wrong type (undefined behaviour, failing assert).
reason: The fix casts to UniqueId64x2* in these added lines; the real argument type is visible only in version_set.cc.

defect: The new event log entry "num_range_deletions" prints table_properties.num_merge_operands instead of num_range_deletions.
reason: The fix corrects this copy-paste error in a line this change added, which is plainly visible in the diff.

defect: The test compares the unsigned CACHE_LINE_SIZE with signed literals (== 64, == 128, ASSERT_EQ with 256), a signed/unsigned mismatch that breaks the Windows (Appveyor) build.
reason: The fix adds U suffixes to exactly these added comparisons; seeing that CACHE_LINE_SIZE is unsigned on Windows requires the port header.

defect: The CacheEntryStatsCollector is kept only as an ordinary low-priority, unpinned cache entry, so with a full cache it is evicted on release and the expensive full-cache scan is redone for each column family.
reason: The fix inserts the collector with high priority and pins it from InternalStats, repairing the design this change introduced; seeing the eviction needs internal_stats.cc and the LRU semantics.

defect: The fix adapts CacheEntryRoleStats to the new foreground/background stats intervals and restores stats_dump_period_sec = 0 so the dump thread cannot interfere with the new timing checks.
reason: The changes to this test file follow the new collector interval logic and API; no failure of the test as written by this change is shown.
